title: Branca Menta Mojito
ldInstructionsRaw:
Combine all ingredients except the soda and shake with ice to chill. Strain into a Collins glass over fresh ice. Top with soda and garnish with a bouquet of fresh mint.
Brown Sugar and Mint SyrupCombine 1 cup of brown sugar and 1 cup of water in a small saucepan over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves. Steep 8-10 mint leaves for 10 minutes in the syrup. Strain out the leaves, cool and bottle the syrup. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
